opening.argument: The presentation describes eBay ShopBot as “a personal shopping assistant right in Facebook Messenger,” providing an ordinary retail method for finding and evaluating products. Users can request items such as Nike running shoes within a stated budget, view an exact listing or similar choices, and select an item to buy. The described process then continues through “confirm and pay” to an order confirmation and email, while the visible interface shows a product listing, price, and shopping controls. Although the service involves commerce, prices, and checkout, these facts show routine retail participation, not an investment offer, credential request, deceptive condition, or unsupported transaction outcome.

citations.quote: eBay ShopBot is a personal shopping assistant right in Facebook Messenger
Try texting something like, I'd like Nike running shoes for under $100.
Once you've found an item you like select View item to see that exact one or choose more like this to
Select confirm and pay and from here you'll see an order confirmation as well as receive a confirmation email.
